notes.title: Rune Update
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We've made some tweaks and added new runes to freshen up your tactics and offer new approaches to combat. We've also squashed a bunch of bugs—thanks to everyone who helped us track them down![/p][h3][b]New Runes: Time to Experiment[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added 18 new runes. Here are some highlights:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lightning’s Reach[/b] Lightning damage now arcs to nearby enemies, great for crowd control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker’s Momentum[/b] Damage increases as you focus on a single target—perfect if you don't like distractions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker’s Patience[/b] Standing still gradually boosts your damage. Ideal for patient warriors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Precision[/b] Increased crit chance against frozen targets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ice Burn[/b] Fire and ice combine to create explosive effects. Opposites attract, after all.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ethereal Surge[/b] Dash now knocks back nearby enemies, helping you maintain personal space.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coward’s Instinct[/b] Taking damage temporarily boosts your movement speed. Not heroic, but handy.[/p][/*][/list][p]And plenty more—full list below.[/p][h3][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved localization—less cringe, more clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced visuals—effects and textures received minor touch-ups.[/p][/*][*][p]General bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p]We’re already working on [b]more content and optimizations[/b]. Expect further rune additions, combat refinements, and deeper gameplay mechanics soon.[/p][p]Thanks for your support![/p][p]— [b]Chaotic Minds Team[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]
[b]📜 Changelog[/b]
[/h2][h3][b]Runes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Lightning’s Reach:[/b] Lightning damage arcs to 2 nearby targets (33% damage, 3s cooldown).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker’s Momentum:[/b] Consecutive hits on the same enemy grant +1% weapon damage, stacks up to 30%, resets when changing target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker’s Patience:[/b] Standing still grants +10% damage per second (max +50%), lost upon movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Precision:[/b] +30% crit chance against ice-afflicted enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ice Burn:[/b] Alternating fire then ice damage applies Ice Burn, increasing slowing effects and dealing burst fire damage at end.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ethereal Surge:[/b] Dash knocks back nearby enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker’s Rage:[/b] +1% weapon damage per 1% missing HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserker’s Fury:[/b] +1% ability damage per 1% missing HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Runic Weapons:[/b] +25% weapon damage, -15% ability damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boreal Affinity:[/b] +25% ability damage, -15% weapon damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arcane Investment:[/b] Each shard on cooldown grants +8% all damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shield of Valor:[/b] Each armor point grants +0.5% all damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sigil of Mastery:[/b] Each unique element on equipped shards reduces ability cooldown by 5%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coward’s Instinct:[/b] Taking damage grants +50% movement speed for 3 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flash Strike:[/b] Melee swings hit an additional time for 50% damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Momentum Transference:[/b] Dash refreshes a random ability on cooldown (10s cooldown).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elemental Conduit:[/b] After using an ability shard, next melee hit deals +50% elemental damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blade-Fused Armor:[/b] Successful melee hits restore 1 armor point (max 1 per second).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Localization & Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved overall game localization quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual enhancements across multiple UI elements and textures.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed runes sometimes not spawning correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed critical shop crashes and general shop functionality issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected player stats tracking bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues causing hidden walls and not working bug report button.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed achievement tracking inconsistencies.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved minor visual/VFX pickup issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: FIXES, FIXES, FIXES!
notes.content:
[h2]🛠 Hey everyone![/h2][p]We’ve seen your feedback — and thank you for being honest with us.[/p][p]Some parts of the game didn’t land the way they should’ve, especially the [b]feel of combat and balance[/b].
But we’ve been working non-stop to fix it — and today we’re releasing a big update that tackles major bugs, improves gameplay flow, and sharpens the visuals across the board.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✅ What We’ve Already Done[/h2][list][*][p][b]Black screen on launch[/b] (which happened in ~10% of runs) — finally fixed. That one was rough.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Everything’s faster[/b]: +75% reload speed, +50% weapon swap speed, +200–300% faster ability casting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebalanced[/b] HP, melee damage and time-to-kill.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better combat feedback[/b]: hitsparks, hit-flash, clearer status effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ability shards[/b] can now be used while shooting with [b]any weapon[/b] (!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed annoying noise[/b] on lower graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New graphics presets[/b] — faster and better-looking across the board.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/a71aae48f47e9cb2c12e279ba7f1592e9d058fce.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔜 What’s Coming Next[/h2][p]We’re just getting started. Coming soon:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lighting Rework[/b] — full overhaul to make the game [b]faster, clearer, and easier to run[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Meta-Progression[/b] — short-term tweaks first, full redesign after.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Animations[/b] — more impact, better feel, sharper feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Runes[/b] — [i]Lightning’s Reach, Cold Precision, Ice Burn[/i]… and 30+ more in nearest updates coming in days.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visuals & Performance[/b] — cleaner VFX, better FPS, smarter effects.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for bearing with us and for your honest feedback.
We’re reading everything, fixing fast, and building the game with you.
Let us know if anything still feels off — and enjoy the smoother experience![/p][p]— [b]Chaotic Minds Team[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]📜 Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed black screen on launch (~10% of players).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed melee hit effects spawning at enemy center instead of impact point.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction is now [b]Press[/b] instead of [b]Hold[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Pyroclasmic Ward[/b] now displays on HUD (not in world).[/p][/*][*][p]Removed VFX noise and updated forest lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated and optimized graphics presets (including default quality).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated anti-aliasing and scalability settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked animation speeds:[/p][list][*][p]Reloads: +75% faster[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon swap: +50% faster[/p][/*][*][p]Ability cast: +200–300% faster[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved pacing across the board.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced HP, enemy count, melee damage, time-to-kill.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability shards now work while shooting.[/p][/*][*][p]Universal hitspark VFX (fire, wood, organic, skeleton, stone types).[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX for enemy status effects (ice, mist, lightning, fire).[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]hit-flash[/b] effect on impact.[/p][/*][*][p]Added screen VFX for dash.[/p][/*][*][p]Added HUD elemental shaders (ice/fire).[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3D AoE dome shader visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new loot VFX (coins, health, pickups).[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]tracer trails[/b] to archer arrows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weak spot visuals and collision on forest enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization across the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Companion, New Bosses, New Chaos
notes.content:
[b]Hail, adventurers![/b]  
Grab a mug of mead and gather round the drakkar – the full release of [i]Vilde[/i] smashes into Steam on [b]June 12th[/b].  

Before we tell you more about the game itself – here’s everything we added since the demo launched three months ago.

[h2] What’s New Since the Demo[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]3 complete boss fights[/b]  

    [list]
    [*] [i]Ent, the Forest Guardian[/i] – now reworked with smarter patterns.
    [*] [i]Ymir, the Ice Colossus[/i] – boss on the Mountain Peak.  
    [*] [i]Forgeheart, the Power Core[/i] – multi-phase mechanical monstrosity.  
    [/list]

[*][b]Companion[/b] – Bjorn — a grumpy Viking who got turned into mead (long story). Now he haunts your bottle, gives unsolicited life advice, and complains in 12 languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/7955b6d35143b07e73969ad276f06833850349d3.gif[/img]

[*][b]18 new enemy types[/b] – Trolls, Huldra, Fire Kobolds, Dragons, Golems and more. Every single one got fresh AI, custom VFX, and a full rebalance.

[*][b]12 new guns[/b] – from Sleipnir’s Shadow rocket-lance to Riftfrost beam cannon. Find ’em, upgrade ’em, break the DPS meter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/cd64517905519cdf3ff112172208b70439bb5fb5.gif[/img]


[*][b]Outer-Temple & Mountain arenas[/b] – procedural layouts, verticality, lava parkour, chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/755fe640ee6ad7366d1b575b24929b4a21767baa.gif[/img]

[*][b]Loot System 2.0[/b] – pick-one-of-three chests plus new arena objectives for bonus drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/246a326b2cf6408c25852a9defcbef14e822840b.gif[/img]

[*][b]Talents 2.0[/b] – multi-layered node trees, new visuals, full rebalance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/895ae5029a616d1d27919135100d4edd9b832079.gif[/img]

[*][b]112 new FX systems[/b] – muzzle flashes, spells, enemy abilites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/2fc8bed1340eb1988818b72cfac74768b0e07dcf.gif[/img]

[*][b]Achievements added[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/09010435f09bb86a6e6d51a8facc5596ea28eea9.gif[/img]

[*][b]Relit levels[/b] – Misty Forest, Mountain Peak, and Fire Temple now 100 % clearer and prettier.

[*][b]HUD & UX Refresh[/b] – clearer interface, better icons, indicating animations.

[*][b]FPS boost[/b] – cleaned shaders, lighter textures, optimized collisions.

[*][b]12-language support[/b] – with a custom font ([i]Huntress[/i]) for Cyrillic and Latin alphabets.

[*][b]Full controller support[/b] 

[*][b]Economy overhaul[/b] – dismantle items, smarter upgrade costs, updated loot system.

[/list]
[h2]And that’s just the beginning. June 12th. Stay tuned.[/h2]

[i]BONUS: Fun Numbers from our Git[/i]
[list]
[*][b]452 bug-fix commits[/b] since the demo.  
[*][b]Longest commit message[/b]: 162 characters (“Many stupid fixes…”).  
[*][b]Unique swear words in commit logs[/b]: 3.  
[*][b]Peak commit window[/b]: 01:00 – 03:00 AM.  
[/list]

notes.title: Vilde - Next Fest Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Huge thanks to all of you playing Vilde during Next Fest and sharing your feedback. We’ve been keeping an eye on everything and pushing fixes as fast as possible. If you spot more issues, let us know—we’re listening and will keep improving the game.

[h1]What’s New & Fixed:[/h1]
- Increased reload speed for all weapons
- Auto-reload for secondary weapons
- FOV slider
- Fixed a bug where changing FOV sometimes broke the camera – and yes, we added it, immediately broke it, and fixed it all in the same update.
- Mouse sensitivity slider – we were just as surprised as you that this wasn’t in the game already
- Axis inversion options – up can be up, or up can be down. We won’t judge
- Fixed treants freezing in place
- Pause menu now actually pauses
- Hold-to-interact now has an animation
- Gates no longer close while you're standing on them – they were a little too eager before
- Jump, dash, and reload now trigger on press, not release
- Fixed Arctic Huntress softlock when switching weapons during a secondary action
- Trickster Box no longer lets you cast spells while shooting


Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll keep the fixes rolling. Thanks for being part of this!

notes.title: First Look at the Misty Forest's Guardian and More
notes.content:
Greetings, warriors! In this edition of our devblog, we're excited to share with you the latest and greatest from our development journey. From brainstorming sessions to final implementations, every step has been a thrilling adventure, and we can't wait to give you a glimpse into our world.

[h3]The Guardian of the Misty Forest: Our First Boss[/h3]
So there we were, brainstorming, and suddenly it hit us: what's more "evil forest" than a giant, ominous tree? Sure, it might seem a bit classic, but hey, classics are classics for a reason, right? We thought, let's give this old idea a new twist. And boom, our first boss was no longer just a tree, it became the embodiment of the forest's dark side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/418d26cc74394076a6a1a62ef61b8f3987a4f40d.png[/img]

[h3]Trents: Mini Menaces[/h3]
We wanted some quirky sidekicks for our boss so the Trents were born. They're like little siblings who are cute but can cause a whole lot of chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/df98384f1e638daf5cceae4ec9f44e77c757d242.png[/img]

[h3]Huldra: The Mystic Forest Diva[/h3]
Huldra was such a fun character to create. We dove into some old myths, and found this! She's not just lurking in the forest, she IS the forest, and she's all about that mystical vibe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/713d8f40d87f09d7dda00ee619186cc9d9d12f94.png[/img]

[h3]Weapon Showcase: Because More is More[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44183299/b5742336da09b24e9582392005561fe392428c60.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet Vilde's New Residents
notes.content:
Greetings, brave souls and occasional Draugr sympathizers! Welcome to the first Vilde dev blog. We've dropped hints on Twitter, but now it's time to venture deeper. Today, we're introducing new characters and a sneak peek at potential weaponry.

[h3] Meet the Draugr [/h3]
First up, we've got the Draugr. What's a Norse-inspired world without a couple of undead folks wandering around, right? 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44183299/4595ebcc0e6c237248b44c2452c01d263509d743.png[/img]

[h3] Say Hello to the Huldufolk [/h3]
Next, the elusive Huldufolk add a touch of magic and mystery to Vilde's dark realms. She's ready to add another layer of intrigue to your adventure in Vilde.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44183299/6c77602ef1e0b1e6dba1ec1f50e2602722f74216.png[/img]

[h3] Vilde, our main character [/h3]
Our hero, Vilde, is fierce and ready for battle. In our FPS, you may not see her much, but every glimpse will be epic.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44183299/05ecb1cd0bbe2597e10faa7406523aa85e01ccc0.png[/img]
